name: Algebraic Encoding of Combinatorial Constraints
description: Replaced the explicit "all elements must be mutually disjoint" exact-cover constraint with an algebraic inequality on the sum of distinct coordinate values ($c_1 + c_2 + c_3 \ge 3k$). Because the coordinate domain is $1..k$ and the subset size is $k$, this inequality mathematically forces the exact-cover property. Models that blindly translate the constraint into code will write an unpruned combination search or a complex ILP and TLE. Models that reason about the bounds will deduce the exact-cover structure and apply the necessary backtracking pruning.
